subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: The gate shall make zero mutations on any path — no committed artifact, no tracker write, no git mutation — its only outputs being the verdict and, on failure, the defect report.
rationale: a read-only validator has no blast radius; the design forecloses self-mutation (`#D-1`, NG-5)
fit_criterion: across all fixtures (clean and failing), a filesystem + tracker + git audit shows zero writes beyond the returned verdict and, on failure, the report at its declared sink
